requirements.summary: Match the RC step against its closed-form solution at every solver point and in two measured times.
Agree between ngspice meas and a separate waveform measurement, and with rough hand estimates.
Keep the inverter delays and the ring period inside the recorded ranges.
Run the named corners and the full grid; order by process and supply and record the temperature inversion.
Show that tighter solver settings move the results by less than the allowed amount.
Judge a seeded Monte Carlo pass count against an exact binomial acceptance region and report its interval.
Never pass a run that did not converge, did not finish, could not measure, produced a value that is not finite, or was not read.
Detect a wrong component, a wrong condition and a shifted process with the planned label.
